{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the cleaned data
df_clean = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_clean['revenue_parsed'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: only completed orders, exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
df_final = df_clean[(df_clean['status'] == 'completed') & 
                     (df_clean['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute average revenue per order by channel and customer_segment
df_grouped = df_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_parsed'].mean().round(2)

# Display the results
print("Average revenue per completed order by channel and customer_segment:")
print(df_grouped)

# Extract values for report
email_new = df_grouped.loc[('email', 'new')]
email_returning = df_grouped.loc[('email', 'returning')]
email_loyal = df_grouped.loc[('email', 'loyal')]
paid_search_new = df_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'new')]
paid_search_returning = df_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'returning')]
paid_search_loyal = df_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'loyal')]

# Compare email vs paid_search within each segment
email_better_new = email_new > paid_search_new
email_better_returning = email_returning > paid_search_returning
email_better_loyal = email_loyal > paid_search_loyal

# Compute overall average revenue for each channel
email_avg = df_final[df_final['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_parsed'].mean().round(2)
paid_search_avg = df_final[df_final['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_parsed'].mean().round(2)

# Print comparison
print(f"\nEmail channel average revenue: ${email_avg}")
print(f"Paid_search channel average revenue: ${paid_search_avg}")

# Check if email outperforms paid_search in any segment
if email_better_new or email_better_returning or email_better_loyal:
    success = True
else:
    success = False

# Output
print(f"Campaign successful? {success}")

# Return for report
print(f"email_new: {email_new}, email_returning: {email_returning}, email_loyal: {email_loyal}")
print(f"paid_search_new: {paid_search_new}, paid_search_returning: {paid_search_returning}, paid_search_loyal: {paid_search_loyal}")
print(f"email_avg: {email_avg}, paid_search_avg: {paid_search_avg}")"}
